reviewStandard: Five routes fail family-member, immune-population, exposome-scope, disease-umbrella, or receptor-isoform-and-complex evidence gates and receive no marked prompt or generation call. Tight Junctions alone is cleared for one immutable, tissue-scale two-cell apical-junction orientation call.
promotionRule: Only a literal Tight Junctions output satisfying the frozen two-complete-cell, one-apical-sealing-band, no-leakage boundary may proceed to exact-hash review. The other five routes remain non-public scientific holds.

routeDecisions.reason: The route does not specify TGF-beta family member, processed state, ligand/receptor complex, species, tissue, or assay.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Specify exact family member, precursor/mature and latent/active state, species, oligomeric or receptor-bound state, compartment, structure source, assay, endpoint, and evidence tier.

routeDecisions.reason: Heterogeneous immune-cell populations, markers, tissues, time points, diseases, and cytokine contexts are collapsed into a universal balance and causal switch.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Define population, specimen, markers/gating, assay, time point, disease/model, cytokine context, comparator, endpoint, and evidence tier.

routeDecisions.reason: The exposome is an all-source lifetime exposure construct rather than one bounded specimen, anatomy, mixture, or measurable state.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Define exposome domain, population, life stage, geography, exposure panel, matrix, measurement method, time window, endpoint, and uncertainty model.

routeDecisions.reason: The route merges distinct autoimmune thyroid diseases and already-reviewed disease pages with minerals, toxicants, microbiome observations, antibodies, and causal claims.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Choose canonical umbrella or disease-specific scope and define exact condition, tissue/pathology state, antibody or analyte, specimen, assay, population, comparator, and evidence tier.

routeDecisions.reason: The route does not specify human TLR4 isoform, domain, membrane state, MD-2/CD14/LPS complex, ligand, activation state, or structure source.
routeDecisions.requiredResolution: Specify species, exact transcript/protein isoform, domain/full-length state, membrane context, partner and ligand composition, activation state, structure accession, and depicted claim boundary.

assets.proposedCaption: Tissue-scale orientation to a tight junction at the apical contact between two adjacent epithelial cells. Protein subtype, copy number, molecular structure, tissue-specific permeability, and disease state are intentionally not depicted; this is an educational reconstruction, not a micrograph.
